fn source(present: bool) -> ?int {
    if present { return 7 }
    return none
}
fn accept(value: ?int) -> int { return value ?? 99 }
fn main() {
    let inferred = some(0)
    let empty: ?int = none
    println(inferred.isSome())
    println(empty.isNone())
    println(inferred ?? 9)
    println(empty ?? -1)
    var assigned: ?int = 1
    assigned = some(2)
    println(assigned ?? -1)
    assigned = none
    println(assigned.isNone())
    assigned = 3
    let copied = assigned
    println(assigned ?? 0)
    println(copied ?? 0)
    println(source(true) ?? 8)
    println(source(false) ?? 8)
    println(accept(5))
    println(accept(none))
    println(accept(some(6)))
    let contextual: int = none ?? 4
    println(contextual)
    let wrapped: ?int = some(1) ?? 2
    println(wrapped ?? 0)
}

fn mark(tag: str, value: int) -> int {
    print(tag)
    return value
}
fn main() {
    let first: ?int = none
    let second: ?int = 2
    let empty: ?int = none
    println(first ?? second ?? mark("X", 3))
    println(first ?? empty ?? mark("F", 3))
    println(second ?? mark("X", 4))
    println(first ?? 4 + 1 == 5)
    println(first ?? 4 | 1)
    let flag: ?bool = false
    println(false || flag ?? true)
    println(true && flag ?? true)
}
